I’ve always had high expectations for Brawlhalla. Let me share my first impressions,there are tons of legends to pick from right away, so the replay value is huge. Each weapon feels distinct, and the light/heavy attack strings plus mind games are seriously addictive. The pace is fast and the fights are intense—low margin for error, but it feels better the more you improve. Matchmaking can sometimes be uneven, but overall it’s a highly replayable platform fighter that keeps me coming back to learn more.
